title: What Memory Clinics Is
definition: Memory Clinics: clinics assessing and strengthening memory.
description:

title: The Signature Vision: Memory Clinics
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Memory Clinics.
description:

title: 2030 — First clinic logistics therapies clear regulators for specific m
definition: 2030 milestone on the Memory Clinics roadmap.
description:
First clinic logistics therapies clear regulators for specific memory training conditions; clinic hulls clinics open in a dozen countries.

What must be true first: the cognitive labs results have to replicate outside the lab, clinic logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and memory training operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed cognitive labs demonstrations, clinic logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting memory training uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Memory Clinics
definition: Estimates Memory Clinics readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Memory Clinics components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a clinic hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Memory Clinics Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Memory Clinics operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Memory Clinics installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 35810 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where cognitive labs monitoring, clinic logistics redundancy, or memory training maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Memory Clinics Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Memory Clinics: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Memory Clinics — clinics assessing and strengthening memory.

Phase 1 — Prove (cognitive labs): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (clinic logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (memory training): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (early dementia): clinic hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and neurology-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
key_points: Four phases: Prove, Build, Operate, Compound.
Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
